$description: SmartBook brand colors. Ink and Lamp carry the identity; Indigo is the product UI primary already used across apps/web and apps/mobile.

ink.role: Primary brand color. Symbol and wordmark on light backgrounds, app icon tile.

night.role: Deep background for splash, dark brand surfaces.

indigo.role: Secondary. Interactive UI primary (links, buttons, focus).

lamp.role: Accent. Symbol on Ink (app icon, favicon, splash). Never as text on white.
